snippet.title: HOMERUN Spin-Off Forever - itch.io
snippet.description:
Swing the bat using the Playdate's unique "Crank" controls.

The playdate is held sideways so the crank mimics a baseball bat.

In this meta-narrative Baseball game your character falls in love with a game and is waiting for it's sequel, but they may wait for the rest of their life. you can collect money and buy cartridges to try different spin-offs of the main game.

https://mubarakalkhuzaee.itch.io/homerun-spin-off-forever
